llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only cover-image generator whose requirements and instructions are consistent with its stated purpose and do not request unrelated credentials or installers.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and shipped references (palettes, renderings, workflow, prompts) align with a cover-image generation helper. The skill asks for no unrelated binaries, environment variables, or external credentials.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions will read the article file and any supplied reference images, build prompts, and save generated artifacts. It also enforces a blocking first-time setup that requires creating/saving an EXTEND.md preferences file before proceeding. This behavior is coherent for a user-preferences driven generator but is notable because the skill will prompt and write files before analyzing content.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code is included (instruction-only). Nothing is downloaded or executed from remote URLs and no archives are extracted.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no credentials or sensitive environment variables. It does reference standard config locations ($HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, project directory) to read/write EXTEND.md, which is reasonable for storing preferences.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill will create/modify a preferences file under .baoyu-skills/baoyu-cover-image/EXTEND.md in project or user config locations and write output image files. always:false and no autonomous-install privileges are present; writing preferences and outputs is expected but the 'CRITICAL' blocking setup behavior is worth noting.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and appears coherent with its purpose. Before installing or invoking it, be aware it will: (1) look for and if absent require you to complete a blocking first-time setup, which creates .baoyu-skills/baoyu-cover-image/EXTEND.md in your project or ~/.baoyu-skills/…; (2) read the article file and any reference images you provide and save generated prompts and output images to disk; and (3) ask the user questions during setup. It does not request credentials or download external code. If you care about privacy or copyright, avoid supplying reference images containing real people or sensitive content, and review EXTEND.md after setup (you can edit or remove it later). If you want tighter control, run the skill in a disposable project directory to inspect files it writes.
